_what: Site knowledge from the operator. Optional input. Rooms on one loop share one controller program in the fit; each room keeps its own building parameters. Facts here are what the operator says, not what the data showed - the fit tests them.
_history: 2026-10-12: operator first read L1 as downstairs radiators (hotter loop = radiators). 2026-10-18: operator corrected it - L1 is probably upstairs floor heating, L2 downstairs radiators; L1 is clearly the hotter loop. The blind evaluation of the earlier run leaned the same way by curve slope (margin 0.27 C/C, weak).

L1.name: Upstairs floor heating
L1.operator_notes: Floor heating, probably on L1 (operator, not 100 % sure). L1 runs clearly hotter than L2. Kitchen also gets warm air rising from downstairs through the open space and balcony.

L2.name: Downstairs radiators
L2.operator_notes: Radiators, probably on L2. Most have no thermostatic valve. The TV room radiator has an analog thermostatic valve, almost closed.

rooms.tv: downstairs, radiator (L2) with an analog thermostatic valve, almost closed

expectations: TV room: small direct heating share (valve almost closed); a local room-feedback structure there would be a real thermostatic valve, not a false positive.
